reason: Both conversations got the power switched off at the consumer unit and correctly identified the Fairy foam as the cause, with no part needed. Conversation 2 asked the key safety unknown (did the water reach the extension lead or sockets), avoided the folk remedies Conversation 1 offered (oil, salt, fabric softener to kill foam), and gave clear advice on telling the landlord. Its weaknesses are over-escalating to an electrician even after the water stopped short, and a stray repeated 'switch off' line after the power was already off. Conversation 1 was more proportionate on escalation but never asked whether the lead or sockets got wet, and its landlord advice was vaguer.
